rationale.conceptual: CNDO/S is a well-known but non-trivial semiempirical method; the solver must use the correct spectroscopic parametrization, compute dipole moments from two contributions (charges + polarization), and project onto principal axes from the inertia tensor. This requires careful implementation beyond a simple library call, but still uses standard quantum chemistry packages.
